summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of SmartSetupUAE (React + Supabase). Found and FIXED one CRITICAL runtime bug that caused /free-zones/:slug pages to crash and fall back to ErrorBoundary 'currently updating' message. After fix, all 10 requested flows pass: home, free-zones listing, ANCFZ detail (74 AED prices + multiple package cards from live Supabase), lead capture (POST 201 to /leads), consultation, /checkout full wizard (POST 201 to /checkout_orders + recalculate_checkout_order RPC 200, order ref SSU-20260622-73BEB generated), /founder-club (AED 999 + AED 1,051 + FAQ + benefits), Error Boundary, scroll reset, console health.

minor.issue: Returns 400 — column 'is_active' does not exist on package_benefits table. Caught gracefully by loadOptionalTable so no user impact, but generates two red console errors on every FreeZoneDetail load. Either remove is_active filter or add the column to the table.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY ME. Line 185 of /app/frontend/src/lib/pricingService.js called a.duration.localeCompare(b.duration) on package_discounts rows. The duration field comes back as a number (or undefined), so .localeCompare crashed with 'TypeError: a.duration.localeCompare is not a function'. This crashed the entire FreeZoneDetail component on every free zone slug (ANCFZ, SPC, SHAMS, IFZA, DMCC, RAKEZ, Meydan, DAFZA). ErrorBoundary caught it and rendered the 'currently updating' fallback, so users saw NO packages/AED prices. Fix applied: coerce both sides to String before .localeCompare.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE — FreeZoneDetail rendering empty: pricingService.getZoneDiscounts called String.prototype.localeCompare on the `duration` field of package_discounts rows. Because the underlying column is numeric (or NULL for some rows), the call threw 'TypeError: a.duration.localeCompare is not a function' during initial render. React's reconciler propagated the error, ErrorBoundary caught it, and showed the 'currently updating' fallback — which mimicked an RLS / empty-data failure but was actually a client-side type crash. REPRODUCTION: open /free-zones/ancfz on any of the 8 seeded zones; console shows the TypeError; page below hero is blank with 'currently updating' fallback. MITIGATION APPLIED: src/lib/pricingService.js:185 changed from `a.duration.localeCompare(b.duration)` to `String(a?.duration ?? '').localeCompare(String(b?.duration ?? ''))`. Verified post-fix: ANCFZ detail renders title, AED 4,888 hero price, and 16+ package cards with prices AED 4,888 → AED 20,700; 0 console TypeErrors; ErrorBoundary fallback no longer triggered. PREVENTION: also normalize `duration` (toString or to a number consistently) inside normalizePackageDiscount so the sort is safe regardless of caller.
